definitions.explanation: Substances added to food or drink for flavor or aroma. Includes both natural spices and artificial flavorings.
Aromatic substances used in perfumes, cosmetics, incense, and other fragrance products.

notes:
Covers both culinary spices/flavorings and aromatic substances. Context usually makes clear which sense is meant.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{天然|てんねん}→天然：03560_tennen⟧{香料|こうりょう} (natural flavoring/fragrance)
- ⟦{人工|じんこう}→人工：11573_jinkou⟧{香料|こうりょう} / ⟦{合成|ごうせい}→合成：12027_gousei⟧{香料|こうりょう} (artificial/synthetic flavoring or fragrance)
- {香料|こうりょう}⟦{貿易|ぼうえき}→貿易：01727_boueki⟧ (spice trade)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦スパイス→スパイス：11054_supaisu⟧ is the common loanword for culinary spices
- ⟦{調味料|ちょうみりょう}→調味料：04941_choumiryou⟧ means seasoning/condiment (broader, includes soy sauce, miso, etc.)
- {香料|こうりょう} is a more formal/technical term that also covers non-food fragrances
